latest_autonomous_wave.rationale: AW38 initially accepted slot generation snapshots from the caller. Because reconstruction may advance immediately after an operation releases its lease, a completion snapshot can observe the new generation and falsely classify work that actually ran entirely on the old selected stack as cross-generation. AW33 already guarantees replacement cannot advance while any shared lease is in flight, so the correct generation authority belongs inside that lease.
